summary: I am a Software Developer with 4 years of UK experience and 10+ years working with websites and web technologies overall. I mainly work with React, TypeScript, Next.js and Ionic, building internal tools, dashboards and mobile apps that people use for real business workflows. I am comfortable working independently, taking a feature from an initial idea through to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support.

items: Architecting and developing a multi-application internal platform using Next.js and TypeScript, integrating company workflows with Microsoft Business Central and working across the frontend, server-side logic, APIs and database layer.

Built the core platform architecture, including authentication, roles and permissions, multi-company support, localisation, caching and reusable npm workspace packages, making the system easier to extend and maintain.

Improved platform security by implementing short-lived JWTs, token rotation and permission-based access controls, helping protect ERP-linked company data and meet external GDPR and security review requirements.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions and introduced Cypress E2E testing and Sentry monitoring, making deployments more repeatable and helping identify issues before and after release.

Own the development and maintenance of 3 production Ionic apps across iOS and Android, including two B2B ordering apps and a B2C ecommerce/dropshipping app, working from requirements through development, testing and release.
Develop mobile features using React, TypeScript, Ionic and Capacitor, including REST API integrations, barcode scanning, order and customer workflows, and Firebase push notifications.
Built small business websites and provided practical IT support for local clients.
Worked on WordPress sites and plugins, covering both frontend changes and backend fixes.
Built e-commerce and company websites with WordPress, WooCommerce and custom plugins.
Helped local clients with IT support, troubleshooting and day-to-day technical issues.
